listings.name: TMS-Redec
listings.current_description: TMS-Redec, established in 1998 and part of the Sekta Group, is an industrial services provider based in Irene offering turnkey solutions such as abrasive blasting, chemical and high-pressure cleaning, corrosion protection and asbestos removal to the energy and petrochemical sectors.

listings.name: Totai
listings.current_description: Totai is a wholesale and distribution business based in Icon Park, Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, supplying gas cookers, heaters, and catering and camping appliances and accessories under the Totai, Elba and Elica brands, with over 60 years in the gas-appliance industry.

listings.name: Uloans
listings.current_description: Uloans is an online fintech lender based in The Willows offering short-term loans, personal loans and debt-consolidation loans from R500 to R180,000, with repayment terms of one to 72 months, and is registered with the National Credit Regulator (NCR).

listings.name: Valuetec Property Valuers - Gauteng (Head Office)
listings.current_description: Valuetec Property Valuers provides independent professional valuations of commercial, agricultural, residential and specialised properties, including wine farms, for purposes ranging from market value and insurance to legal, tax and deceased estate matters, with valuers registered with the SACPVP and SAIV.

listings.name: Venue Nouveau
listings.current_description: Venue Nouveau is a wedding and events venue in Zwavelpoort set against the Bronberg mountains, offering a modern bohemian-chic, eco-conscious setting with indoor and outdoor ceremony and reception spaces, on-site guest accommodation, and a pet-friendly policy welcoming dogs at weddings.

listings.name: Verimark Wonderpark
listings.current_description: Verimark Wonderpark is a branch of the Verimark retail chain in Wonderpark Shopping Centre, selling vacuums, mops and brooms, kitchen appliances and cookware, fitness equipment, beauty devices, and DIY, outdoor and toy products under the brand's "Quality innovations, guaranteed" promise.

listings.name: Vibro Bricks and Paving PTA East
listings.current_description: Vibro Bricks and Paving PTA East has manufactured and supplied concrete bricks, kerbs and paving for 24 years, offering cobble, bevel and interlocking pavers, blocks and retaining wall systems for domestic, industrial and decorative construction projects from its Zwavelpoort plant.

listings.name: Victoria Hotel
listings.current_description: Victoria Hotel is Pretoria's oldest operating hotel, established in 1894 on Scheiding Street in the CBD, with individually named heritage rooms, a banquet hall, a conference hall, and a dining room serving breakfast and lunch buffets alongside a small pub.

listings.name: vida e caffè Hazeldean Square
listings.current_description: vida e caffe Hazeldean Square is a branch of Africa's largest privately owned speciality coffee franchise, serving espresso-based drinks, smoothies, juices, and breakfast, lunch and snack items with vegetarian, vegan, Halal and dairy-free options, at Hazeldean Square in Pretoria East.

listings.name: Voortrekker Monument
listings.current_description: The Voortrekker Monument is a heritage site and museum in Groenkloof commemorating the Great Trek, featuring the Kruger Death Room, the Transvaal Voortrekkers Museum, the Heritage Centre and Fort Schanskop, with on-site dining, shops and guided tours available by arrangement.

listings.name: WATCON GROUP
listings.current_description: WATCON GROUP is a building and construction company in East Lynne established in 1969, specialising in waterproofing for roofs, parking decks, basements and balconies, painting and renovation, and rising damp solutions, plus scaffolding, carpentry, aluminium shopfronts and light steel construction.

listings.name: Weather Master
listings.current_description: Weather Master, established in 1953 and known as the original inventor of the louvre awning, manufactures and installs louvre awnings, fixed awnings and sun screens for residential, commercial and architectural clients across Gauteng, the Free State and the Northern Cape.

listings.name: Weldhagen Eggs (Pty) Ltd (Warehouse wholesaler)
listings.current_description: Weldhagen Eggs, a family-owned business operating since 1968, grades and distributes farm-fresh eggs from a facility processing up to 108,000 eggs an hour, delivering next-day to over 1,500 retail and commercial customers across Gauteng, North West and Limpopo.

listings.name: WHM Labour Law Advisors
listings.current_description: WHM Labour Law Advisors is a labour law and HR advisory firm with over 25 years of experience, offering CCMA representation, disciplinary hearing support, misconduct investigations, HR policy design, recruitment support, payroll solutions and 24/7 telephonic advice for employers.

listings.name: Woolworths Midrand Distribution Centre
listings.current_description: Woolworths' distribution centre on Olievenhoutbosch Road in Louwlardia, an 80,000m2 facility completed in 2006 that houses off-site stockrooms for clothing, home, groceries, perishables and returnable crates, and runs a grid-tied solar PV system covering part of its power needs.

listings.name: Wrapsa Packaging & Manufacturing
listings.current_description: Wrapsa Packaging & Manufacturing, at the corner of Bell and Edison Crescent in Hennopspark, is part of the Wrapsa pharmaceutical contract manufacturing business, providing blister packaging, liquid-fill packaging, carton manufacturing, custom design and labelling and printing services for pharmaceutical clients.

listings.name: XContent Business Solutions
listings.current_description: XContent Business Solutions is a Microsoft cloud partner founded in 2009, offering cloud deployment, migration, support and management, AI-enhanced Azure and Microsoft 365 dashboards, digital identity tools, a CRM product and master product data management, from its Highveld, Centurion office.

listings.name: African Human Logistics
listings.current_description: African Human Logistics is a Centurion-based company founded in 2007, serving as the local base for INX Software -- an enterprise workforce logistics, safety, compliance and environment management platform -- across Africa, serving industries including mining, manufacturing, retail, aviation and construction.

listings.name: Africlock
listings.current_description: Africlock is an Eldoraigne-based developer and supplier of time and attendance, payroll and diesel control systems, offering fingerprint, face-recognition and tag-based clock-in hardware and software; the company has operated since 1989 and serves more than 3,500 clients across South Africa.

listings.name: Amantle Property Management
listings.current_description: Amantle Property Management is a residential property management company based in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, managing rental properties across Capital Park, Eloffsdal, Erasmuskloof, Lotus Gardens, Mayville, Moreleta Park, Pretoria Central, Pretoria North, Pretoria West and Sunnyside, handling deposits, rent collection and tenant communication.

listings.name: Anaprop Property Management
listings.current_description: Anaprop Property Management is a property development and management company in Centurion, a subsidiary of JSE-listed Acsion Limited, that manages the Mall@Reds shopping centre from its on-site office and has developed more than 257,000 square metres of retail space.

listings.name: ARINT Consulting Services South Africa
listings.current_description: ARINT South Africa is a Centurion-headquartered engineering and technical SHEQ services firm, originally formed in Lyon, France in 2002, offering consulting engineering, project management, asset management, risk-based inspection and specialist training; the company is ISO 9001 certified and BBBEE Level 3.

listings.name: Aroma Gourmet Coffee Roastery
listings.current_description: Aroma Gourmet Coffee Roastery is the flagship branch of the Pretoria coffee chain, located at Florents Heights, corner Lynnwood Road and Pienaar Street, Brooklyn, featuring an in-store roastery, breakfast menu, and a gelato and waffle lounge alongside sandwiches, salads and cheesecake.

listings.name: Arrie Nel Annlin Pharmacy
listings.current_description: Arrie Nel Annlin Pharmacy is a branch of the Arrie Nel Pharmacy Group in Annlin, Pretoria -- a family-owned group that started in 2000 with 3 pharmacies and has since grown to 28 pharmacies plus a wholesaler supplying 70 non-group pharmacies.

listings.name: Arrow Park
listings.current_description: Arrow Park is a modern industrial and logistics business park in Kosmosdal, Centurion, built in phases between 2023 and 2024 in the Samrand node between Centurion and Midrand, offering A-grade warehouse space with perimeter security fencing and 24/7 CCTV monitoring.

listings.name: Ashley Paulse
listings.current_description: Ashley Paulse is a business consultancy based in Arcadia, Pretoria, focused on developing taxi-industry-owned energy infrastructure -- fuel procurement, storage and retail garages -- alongside banking and fintech solutions aimed at formalising and modernising South Africa's taxi and public transport sector.

listings.name: Backyard Pots and Plants
listings.current_description: Backyard Pots and Plants is a garden centre and plant nursery in Rietfontein, founded in October 2022, that grew from a small hobby into a distributor and supplier of plants and garden-related products for hobbyists, nurseries and growers of all sizes.

listings.name: Beluga Deere Surveys
listings.current_description: Beluga Deere Surveys, established in 1988 (previously AJK Surveys) and run as a father-and-son team from Pierre van Ryneveld Park, is a turnkey land-surveying practice using GPS and GNSS, 3D laser scanning and digital photography for accurate contour and boundary surveys.

listings.name: Berry Astrapak MARCOM
listings.current_description: Berry Astrapak MARCOM, formerly Marcom Plastics and part of the Astrapak Group founded in 1996 (later RPC Astrapak, now US-owned Berry Astrapak), manufactures rigid plastic packaging -- tubs, jars, bottles, roll-ons, tubes, closures and caps -- from Pepler Street in Rosslyn.

listings.name: Best Enough Trading & Projects
listings.current_description: Best Enough Trading & Projects is a Level 1 B-BBEE, 100% Black-owned civil works company offering water reticulation, roads and stormwater projects, bulk water projects, air conditioning and refrigeration, and concrete manufacturing through its Bestcrete division, serving government and private-sector clients.

listings.name: Bidvest Panalpina Logistics
listings.current_description: Bidvest Panalpina Logistics, part of Bidvest International Logistics, is a supply chain and freight operator in the Rosslyn industrial area, providing air, ocean and road freight, warehousing and customs broking with an industry-specific focus on automotive, chemicals, FMCG and pharmaceutical clients.

listings.name: Bigtime Strategic Group
listings.current_description: Bigtime Strategic Group, based at Podium at Menlyn in Lynnwood Glen, is a diversified group of Black-owned South African companies spanning ICT, aviation, insurance, financial services, agriculture and events management, founded in 2000 from its flagship Computer Ink and Media Solutions.

listings.name: BrandXtreme
listings.current_description: BrandXtreme is a Pretoria-based creative agency founded in 1997 offering graphic and web design, large-format printing, vehicle branding and signage, and social media management for small, medium, and large businesses, and was a finalist in the 2011 702 Small Business Awards.

listings.name: Brizoway Construction
listings.current_description: Brizoway Construction is a Pretoria-based construction company specializing in residential housing projects, from affordable to mid-high income and mega housing developments, as well as renovations and project management, and states it has built over 8,000 units since starting in 2010.

listings.name: Cafe 41 (Rigel)
listings.current_description: Cafe 41 (Rigel) is a cafe-restaurant in the Waterkloof Rand Centre serving bakery items, burgers, pizzas, seafood and vegetarian dishes alongside coffee, with a licensed bar, outdoor seating and WiFi in a relaxed, cosmopolitan setting popular for business meetings and lunches.

listings.name: Capital Craft Beer Academy
listings.current_description: Capital Craft Beer Academy is a craft-beer-focused restaurant and bar with an industrial-Bavarian-styled interior and an outdoor deck, stocking well over 100 South African and imported craft beers alongside a menu of burgers, sandwiches, ribs, wings and platters, in Menlo Park.

listings.name: Casa Flora Guest House
listings.current_description: Casa Flora is a self-catering guest house inside the gated Silver Lakes Golf Estate in Pretoria East, offering five en-suite rooms, a pool and entertainment area, and a conference room for up to 15 delegates, aimed at business and leisure travellers.

listings.name: Casablanca Manor Wedding, Function and Conference Venue
listings.current_description: Casablanca Manor is a wedding, function and conference venue in Donkerhoek, Pretoria East, offering multiple indoor and outdoor spaces including an indoor chapel, open-air chapel and garden settings, along with in-house wedding planning, catering and complimentary accommodation for the bridal couple.

listings.name: Cash Crusaders (Blu Valley Mall)
listings.current_description: Cash Crusaders at Blu Valley Mall is a secondhand goods and pawn shop that buys and sells electronics, appliances, tools and other quality used and new goods, and offers secured cash loans, at its store in Blu Valley Mall, The Reeds.

listings.name: Cavanagh & Richards Attorneys
listings.current_description: Cavanagh & Richards Attorneys is a full-service law firm operating across six South African branches, practicing in areas including labour law, commercial law, criminal law, conveyancing, family law, corporate law, and litigation for clients ranging from JSE-listed companies to financial institutions.

listings.name: CCBSA Pretoria West
listings.current_description: CCBSA Pretoria West is one of Coca-Cola Beverages South Africa's manufacturing and bottling plants, part of the CCBSA group formed in 2016 from the merger of six non-alcoholic ready-to-drink bottling operations. The plant is located on Market Street in Booysens, Pretoria.

listings.name: Centurion Letting & Sales
listings.current_description: Centurion Letting & Sales is a real estate agency in Wierdapark, Centurion, handling residential, commercial, and industrial property sales and rentals across Centurion, Pretoria, and Midrand, citing over 25 years in the market and with listings on Property24 and Private Property.

listings.name: Chas Everitt Centurion Estate Agency
listings.current_description: Chas Everitt Centurion Estate Agency, based in Wierdapark, is a franchise office of the Chas Everitt International Property Group, a South African real estate company with nearly 50 years in the industry, offering property sales, rentals, bond origination and conveyancing support.

listings.name: Chauke tree felling
listings.current_description: Chauke Tree Felling provides tree removal and garden maintenance across Pretoria and North Gauteng, including tree felling, pruning, hedge trimming, stump removal, site clearance and 24-hour emergency tree removal, and states it is fully insured with over 20 years of experience.

listings.name: Check Your Business Value
listings.current_description: Check Your Business Value, based in Elardus Park, Pretoria, provides business valuation and business plan development services for small and medium enterprises, drawing on chartered accountants, tax specialists and lawyers, and also offers a free basic valuation calculator on its website.

listings.name: Chimu Log homes
listings.current_description: Chimu Log Homes (CHIMU Construction) is a family-run building company based in Akasia that designs and builds log homes, Wendy houses, Nutec cabins, cottages, sheds and classrooms using CCA-treated pine and Nutec materials, with standard structures typically completed in 3-7 days.

listings.name: Chrome Catering Equipment
listings.current_description: Chrome Catering Equipment, trading as Soft-Ice and the sole importer of the ChromeCater brand, supplies commercial catering equipment from its Montana Park showroom, including soft-serve and slush machines, bakery equipment, refrigeration and butchery tools, with nationwide courier delivery and layby options.

listings.name: CJLM Electroplating CC
listings.current_description: CJLM Electroplating CC is an electroplating plant in Hermanstad, Pretoria with over 40 years in the industry, applying plating and finishes (including chrome, brass, and black oxide) to metal parts such as motorcycle and car components, badges, and trophy skull mounts.

listings.name: Compass Land Surveyors
listings.current_description: Compass Land Surveyors is a professional land surveying firm in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, offering cadastral surveys (boundary relocation, subdivisions, consolidations), control survey networks, topographical surveys, aerial drone surveys, and construction and engineering surveys for residential, commercial, agricultural, and public sector projects.

listings.name: Compleo
listings.current_description: Compleo is an office equipment and digital printing supplier offering production printing solutions, multifunction printers, wide-format printers, document scanners, workflow and document management solutions, plus business connectivity, hosting, and voice/video communication services, based at Byls Bridge Office Park in Centurion.
